figures.caption: Fig. 2. Case studies of ReVR. Tend., Agr., and Amb. denote historical tendency, label agreement, and ambiguity, with positive tendency favoring fake news. Radar plots show VLM-generated support scores for the real (blue, sRm) and fake (orange, sFm) hypotheses under each displayed concept. q and τ denote the override probability and threshold. Conflict-resolution rationales are omitted for space.
Table 1. Coarse-level accuracy and F1 (%). Best and secondbest results are bold and underlined.

Fig. 1. Framework overview of ReVR. (a) We construct a reusable concept library through grounded proposal, iterative consolidation, and historical profiling. (b) Query-focused and coverage-oriented verification assess unseen news, with learned conflict resolution selecting between disagreeing predictions.
